title: Ziffr Deck Template (ziffr.deck-template/3)
description: A starting point for a deck, as ziffr.deck-template/2, whose words and boxes may show live values: they name the Slots their Placeholders count. It holds no code, image or link.

name.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses

description.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses

slots.description: The Metrics it takes, in order; one Slot can fill several widgets.

label.description: plain text, without markup or web addresses

multiple.description: Takes one or more Metrics (small multiples) instead of exactly one.

suggests.description: in a Pack: the key of one of its Metric Catalog entries, offered to fill the Slot

theme.description: in a Pack: the key of one of its Themes, which a deck made from the template starts with

slides.description: The slides, in order, each 1280 by 720 pixels.

cover.description: A cover: no logo, footer or number of the Theme, and not counted in page numbers.

settings.description: What the widget is set to; left out, the view's defaults.

rows.description: How many rows a table shows.

fullPeriods.description: Leave out a period that is not over yet.
